ledger_ref.description: skip scaling when hdisplay or vdisplay is 0

snapshot.path: parent tree is the m-054 tree, not a new archived snapshot

semantics.summary: Before either div_u64, hdisplay==0 or vdisplay==0 sets scale_enable and enhancer_enable false and jumps to mclk_calc. It does not return -EINVAL and does not clamp the divisor to 1. The combine width path needs hdisplay>2048, so it does not meet this guard. Known unguarded form, reachability not proven: src==0 with crtc_w!=0 still reaches div_u64(src_w).
